summary.text: Marian Matthews is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2020, representing District 27 in Bernalillo County.
Matthews sits on the House Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee and the House Commerce and Economic Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Matthews's occupation as retired and a district office in Albuquerque.

Between sessions, Matthews is a member of the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee, the Mortgage Finance Authority Act Oversight Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
